clues.text: After her father and mother died, her cousin Mordecai raised her as his own daughter in Susa.
King Xerxes loved her more than all the other women and placed the royal crown on her head.
Taken into the king's palace in Susa, she kept her people and lineage secret because Mordecai told her to.
She told King Xerxes of a plot by two eunuchs guarding the entrance to assassinate him.
Before going to the Persian king without being summoned, she asked the Jews in Susa to fast three days.
Standing uninvited in the inner court, she was spared when Xerxes held out his gold scepter to her.
At a banquet with the Persian king, she named Haman as the enemy plotting to destroy her people.
